Senior / Lead Creative Strategist

Simmer | London | Full-time

Simmer is one of the UK's fastest-growing consumer brands, built on a simple idea: healthy food should taste extraordinary. Founded by brothers Simmy and Jhai with £10 of ingredients, we've grown into a profitable, bootstrapped business generating over £100m in annual recurring revenue, ranking #5 in The Sunday Times 100.

But we still think we're early.

Our ambition is to become the defining brand in healthy eating.

We're fully founder-led, without private equity or corporate layers. The founders remain deeply involved in the business, decisions happen quickly and the people who join us have the opportunity to materially shape what Simmer becomes.

We've built our growth through product quality, performance marketing and founder-led storytelling. Creative has been one of our biggest competitive advantages, helping us reach tens of thousands of customers across the UK.

Now we want to take that advantage much further.

The opportunity

We're looking for an exceptional Senior / Lead Creative Strategist
who understands the relationship between creative, consumer behaviour and commercial performance.

Someone who can look at our acquisition engine, understand what is driving growth today and identify what could make it significantly better tomorrow.

You'll have access to meaningful paid media investment, high volumes of creative testing, rich performance data and a talented team of producers and editors who can bring ideas to life.

You'll work directly with our founder and closely with the people responsible for growth, helping determine which audiences we target, what messages resonate and where we invest our creative efforts.

This isn't a role for someone who simply writes briefs or comes up with interesting ideas.

We want someone who can answer the harder questions:
Why are certain ads outperforming everything else?
Which audiences and customer motivations are we not reaching?
Where are we seeing creative fatigue or diminishing returns, and what should we do about it?
Which new concepts, formats and messages could materially improve acquisition?
How do we turn individual creative wins into a repeatable engine for growth?
Where should we focus our time, creative resources and media investment to generate the greatest return?

You might be a senior Creative Strategist with exceptional performance marketing knowledge, or an experienced Performance Marketer with outstanding creative instincts.

We're open-minded about your background and title. What matters is your ability to combine commercial insight, creative thinking and execution to deliver measurable growth.
For the right person, the role could extend into broader performance marketing ownership.

What you'll do

Own the creative growth opportunity

Understand our acquisition performance, identify the biggest opportunities and develop a clear creative strategy to capture them. Think beyond individual campaigns to customer segments, positioning, messaging and sustainable growth.

Turn performance data into better creative

Go deep into Meta performance, CAC, conversion, creative fatigue, testing results and customer behaviour. Understand why something works, not simply whether it works, and translate those insights into clear creative decisions.

Develop concepts that move the numbers

Create and shape compelling concepts, hooks, scripts and briefs grounded in consumer psychology and commercial insight. Work closely with our production team, editors and creators to turn ideas into high-performing content.

Build a stronger experimentation engine

Identify what we should test, how we should test it and what we'll learn. Develop new angles, challenge assumptions, iterate quickly and scale ideas that demonstrate genuine incremental value.

Connect creative and media performance

Work across creative and performance to understand how messaging, audiences, spend and acquisition economics interact. Help shape decisions around what to produce, what to scale and where to focus investment.

Raise the standard

Develop a strong point of view on what great performance creative looks like. Challenge mediocre ideas, improve the quality of thinking and help the team become more commercially effective without slowing down execution.

Take ownership of outcomes

We're not looking for someone who measures success by how many briefs they've written or campaigns they've launched. We care about what improves as a result of their work.

What we're looking for

We're less interested in how impressive your job title sounds or how many people you've managed than the quality of your thinking, the decisions you've made and the results you've delivered.

You'll bring:
Proven performance impact.
You've helped improve customer acquisition through creative strategy, paid social or a combination of both, and can explain what you personally contributed.
Strong Meta and acquisition knowledge.
You understand the mechanics of paid social, creative testing, CAC, conversion and scaling performance.
Exceptional creative judgement.
You instinctively understand hooks, storytelling, consumer psychology, messaging and what makes people pay attention and take action.
Analytical depth.
You're comfortable working with performance data, spotting patterns, forming hypotheses and making decisions that improve commercial outcomes.
Experience at pace.
You've worked in an environment where creative is tested frequently, feedback is immediate and strong ideas are developed and iterated quickly.
Ownership and ambition.
You're comfortable taking responsibility, challenging assumptions and finding solutions without waiting to be told what to do.
Intellectual curiosity and humility.
You're constantly learning, testing your thinking and willing to change your mind when the evidence says you should.

Why Simmer?

A meaningful growth challenge

We've already built a £100m+ ARR business. The next stage isn't about proving the model works. It's about finding the opportunities that take us much further.

Real scale, without corporate complexity

You'll have meaningful media investment, performance data and creative resources, but still be close enough to the decisions to make things happen quickly.

Work directly with the founder

You'll work closely with Simmy, shaping the creative and commercial decisions that influence how the business grows.

Influence the work, not just the output

We want someone who challenges our thinking, identifies opportunities we've missed and raises the quality of decisions across creative and performance.

A role that can grow with you

We're open-minded about where this role develops. For someone with the right capabilities, there's significant scope to take on broader ownership across creative strategy, performance marketing and growth.

Who will thrive here?

Someone who's commercially sharp, creatively ambitious and intellectually curious.
Someone who can go from analysing acquisition performance to developing an exceptional creative concept, then work with a team to bring it to life.
Someone who has strong opinions but isn't attached to being right.
Someone who values pace, takes ownership and cares as much about commercial results as the quality of the ideas.
Most importantly, someone who's excited by the opportunity to make a measurable difference to one of the UK's fastest-growing consumer businesses.

If you love understanding why creative works, identifying growth opportunities others miss and turning those insights into commercial results, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV and, ideally, examples of performance creative or acquisition initiatives you've led, the thinking behind them and the results they delivered.

About Us:

Who is GBM Group I hear you ask? Well, you probably already know who we are without realising it!
We own and operate a network of highly engaged youth communities on social media. We have numerous pages - including Great British Memes, That Girl Page, That Student Page, and more which across all social channels reach over 500 million people every month. The vast majority of our social following comes directly from our home market: the UK.

At GBM, we take pride in what we do and make sure client needs are met while maintaining total authenticity for our nurtured communities. All campaigns receive meticulous care and attention to detail - nothing goes live unless the GBM team is 100% happy with it.

So to sum it up for you: we are a fast-growing, chronically online team making organic and paid memes, video content, and culture-defining campaigns for the masses!

Sound like a bit of you? Read on!

The Role

We’re split into three core departments: Partnerships, Editorial, and Creative. Reporting directly to the Founder & CEO as one of three direct reports, you will sit within the Senior Leadership Team alongside the Director of Commercial Strategy and Editorial Lead. Together, you will define and drive the overarching creative vision for the business, champion award-winning ideas, and spearhead our highest-stakes brand pitches.

This isn't a passive direction role - it's a hybrid of high-level strategic vision, team mentorship, and hands-on execution. You will directly lead and mentor a focused (and growing) creative squad of 4, guiding their day-to-day output while working collaboratively across the wider 20-person agency to turn raw sparks into high-impact campaigns that people actively share, not just scroll past.

If you bring a minimum of 7 years of experience, a track record of winning big pitches, and an instinct for creating content that breaks the internet while delivering commercial results, this is your stage.

Key Responsibilities:

Vision & Executive Alignment

Drive Strategic Vision: Partner directly with the CEO and Marketing Director to shape, evolve, and execute the long-term creative vision and identity for GBM Group and its client portfolio.
Elevate Creative Standards: Champion award-winning, culture-first concepts that push boundaries, drive industry conversation, and set new benchmarks for social media marketing.
Internal & External Ambassadorship: Act as a key creative spokesperson for GBM Group at industry events, awards, and high-profile partner activations.

Team Leadership & Management

Lead & Mentor: Manage, direct, and nurture the day-to-day output of designers, art directors, copywriters, and video producers, helping them grow their skills and execute at the highest level.
Workflow & Quality Control: Monitor execution standards across all outputs, remove creative or process bottlenecks, and keep projects running on schedule, on budget, and on scope.
Culture & Inspiration: Foster a collaborative, fast-paced environment where brave ideas are encouraged and execution is sharp.

Pitches & Strategic Growth

Own the Big Pitches: Lead creative strategy and concept development for major new business briefs, pitch proposals, and reactive commercial opportunities (RTBs).
Client & Stakeholder Presentations: Confidently pitch big ideas directly to senior client stakeholders, brand partners, and agency leads, instilling total trust in our creative capability.
Proactive Commercial Planning: Look ahead at cultural moments, calendar dates, and emerging trends to package up proactive campaigns for new and existing clients.

Project Direction & Execution

End-to-End Oversight: Oversee individual creative projects, digital assets, and integrated campaigns from initial ideation and script writing to final production and edit.
Cross-Department Collaboration: Work fluidly alongside account managers, strategy planners, performance teams, and external production partners to align creative with business outcomes.
Hands-on Production: Maintain a grounded, hands-on approach when needed - attending or running shoots, guiding edits, and ensuring content remains native, fast, and authentic to our channels.

What We’re Looking For

Experience: Minimum 7+ years in a senior creative role (Agency or Publisher environment) with a proven track record of managing creative teams and winning major pitches.
Track Record: Portfolio of award-winning or culture-defining social campaigns that demonstrate exceptional storytelling, viral reach, and commercial performance.
Leadership & Vision: Exceptional leadership ability—proven experience managing designers, copywriters, and video editors while collaborating directly with C-suite executives.
Deep Social Mastery: An innate understanding of UK youth culture, meme formats, algorithm nuances, and platform-specific trends across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, Snapchat, and Facebook.
Hands-on Technical Fluency: Proficient in the tools of the trade (CapCut, Premiere Pro, Photoshop/Canva) with end-to-end understanding of social video production and editing.
Pitch & Presentation Mastery: Charismatic presentation skills with a history of writing and pitching winning proposals directly to senior brand clients.
Chaos with Purpose: An out-of-the-box thinker who knows when to be subtle, when to be fast, and when to cause a bit of internet chaos to command attention.
Adaptability: A self-starter who thrives in a high-velocity, start-up environment where speed and quality go hand-in-hand.

Creative Excellence & Impact: Consistently delivering award-winning campaigns that generate massive engagement, organic shares, and industry recognition across our 500M+ monthly reach network.
Commercial Pitch Win Rate: Unlocking new revenue by conceptualising and pitching unbeatable creative proposals to tier-one brand clients alongside the leadership team.
Team Growth & Efficiency: Cultivating a high-performing, inspired creative team with streamlined workflows, minimal bottlenecks, and consistently high output standards.
Strategic Alignment: Working seamlessly with the CEO and Marketing Director and Editorial Lead to position GBM Group as the premier youth culture agency in the UK.

We’d love to see your CV, portfolio/showreel of award-winning or high-performing campaigns, plus a short video application where you can let your creative personality shine.

Whether it’s jumping on a trend, breaking down a pitch win, or putting together a fast-paced edit, show us what makes you the right person to lead our creative vision. No rigid rules - the bolder and more creative, the better!

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin.

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK & DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting
Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree required
5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience
Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise
Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats
Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results
Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously
Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams

Preferred:

Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, or other paid platforms
Experience briefing and working with UGC creators
Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin.

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Bachelor’s degree required
5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience
Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise
Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats
Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results
Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously
Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams

Preferred:

Experience briefing and working with UGC creators
Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands
